reason: Both correctly identify normal cooling-fan run-on with no part or repair needed, and neither raises false alarms. Conversation 1 adds the useful detail that run-on is longer after grill/combi use, explicitly addresses the 'old one never did that' comparison (basic solo vs combi), and gives a more complete fault boundary: constant running when cold/idle, indefinite running, or burning smell means contact an engineer rather than DIY, which matches the ground truth's 'only a fault if it runs constantly when cold' direction. Conversation 2 is clear and reassuring but its fault boundary is limited to abnormal noises and 'eventually stops', missing the cold/idle-running check and any escalation path (e.g. Samsung warranty), so it is slightly less complete.
